strings.ui_help_close: Close the compass markers window and return to the game. Marker choices are already saved.
strings.ui_help_tab_markers: Choose which map pins appear on the compass for this character and world.
strings.ui_help_tab_hud: Adjust the local clock, weather and HUD presentation.
strings.ui_help_tab_compass: Adjust the compass strip, heading and nearby marker display.
strings.ui_help_tab_visibility: Choose which visual effects to remove. Server rules can keep an effect enabled.
strings.ui_help_tab_map: Adjust map exploration radius, tidy pin presentation and Exploration skill settings.
strings.ui_help_map_cursor: Give the gamepad focus to the marker map. Move with the left stick, zoom with the triggers and select a pin with A.
strings.ui_help_marker_type: Show or hide all compass pins of this type. Individually selected pins can remain visible.
strings.ui_help_marker_pin: Toggle this pin on the compass. If its type is enabled, turn that type off before hiding this pin individually.
strings.ui_help_marker_map: Select a pin to change its compass visibility. Pins enabled by their type stay visible until that type is disabled.
strings.ui_help_decrease: Decrease this setting by one step, within its allowed range.
strings.ui_help_increase: Increase this setting by one step, within its allowed range.
strings.tidy_pins_description: Show pin names only under the mouse or gamepad map cursor (hold Show All Names Key for every name), use smaller icons, grow the hovered pin and fade crossed-out pins. Player, ping and shout pins keep their size and opacity. Off restores the previous presentation. Local visual setting; pin data and map fog stay unchanged.
strings.held_notice: This server does not run Cairn: Mistlands, particle and cave mist stay on and the map radius keeps its default limits.
strings.skill_exploration_description: Uncovering the map. Widens your map radius on land and softens the loss to darkness and weather.
strings.vantage: Vantage: the view from up here uncovers more of the map.
strings.radius_inputs: Radius {0} m (base {1} × {2}). Light {3}, weather {4}, altitude {5}, location {6}
strings.step_aside_radius: Cairn's map radius is off while {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_visibility: Cairn's fog and smoke removal is off while {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_hud: Cairn's time and weather HUD is off while {0} is installed.
strings.ui_markers_hint: Select a pin or type to show it on the compass. Drag the map to pan; scroll to zoom.
strings.ui_shown_by_type: This pin is shown by its {0} type. Turn off that type first.
strings.help_setting_1_enabled: Compute Cairn's exploration radius. Off uses the game's 100 m base and skill/ship factors.
strings.help_setting_1_minimum_radius: Smallest radius in meters, limited by Maximum Radius.
strings.help_setting_1_maximum_radius: Largest radius in meters. Large values can affect performance.
strings.help_setting_1_land_explore_radius: Land radius near sea level; the game uses 100 m.
strings.help_setting_1_sea_explore_radius: Sea radius when someone within 21 m steers a ship.
strings.help_setting_1_altitude_radius_bonus: Each 100 m of altitude adds this share of land radius; 0 disables.
strings.help_setting_1_forest_radius_penalty: Subtract this share in forests; 0 disables.
strings.help_setting_1_daylight_radius_scale: Strength of the daylight bonus and darkness penalty; 0 disables.
strings.help_setting_1_weather_radius_scale: Strength of the fog, mist and snowstorm penalty; 0 disables.
strings.help_setting_1_show_radius: Show the current exploration radius on the HUD.
strings.help_setting_1_show_radius_inputs: Retained ignored preference. The saved value is preserved for compatibility; it does not show radius inputs or enable diagnostic logging.
strings.help_setting_4_enabled: Show the clock, weather and compass HUD.
strings.help_setting_4_toggle_key: Keyboard key to show or hide the HUD.
strings.help_setting_4_settings_key: Keyboard key to open Cairn's compass markers window.
strings.help_setting_4_show_time: Show the time; sun/moon marks appear if supported by the game font.
strings.help_setting_4_show_forecast: Shows the next weather on the clock line: its name, the minutes until the shared world clock changes, and the wind then. Skips environments Tempest has switched off. Seasonal names such as Clear Winter use that weather's name and icon. The prediction uses the current season's list, so a change after the season turns can differ. Your own display setting.
strings.help_setting_4_use_24_hour: On uses 24 hours; off uses 12 hours.
strings.help_setting_4_strip_degrees: Angle covered by the compass strip.
strings.help_setting_4_compass_strip_width: Width of the compass plank; 240 is the standard width. The time line, compass marks and pins move at once.
strings.help_setting_4_show_heading: Show exact degrees below the compass.
strings.help_setting_4_show_markers: Show chosen map pins on the compass.
strings.help_setting_4_max_markers: Maximum number of markers, nearest first.
strings.help_setting_4_max_distance: Maximum marker distance in meters; 0 shows all.
strings.help_setting_4_tempest_warnings: Show Tempest warnings and countdowns in the HUD.
strings.help_setting_4_gamepad_toggle: Gamepad chord to toggle the HUD; empty disables.
strings.help_setting_4_gamepad_settings: Gamepad chord to open the compass markers window; empty disables.
strings.help_setting_5_exploration_enabled: Enable experience and perks; stored levels are preserved when off.
strings.help_setting_5_experience_per_square_kil: Experience for each square kilometer of newly uncovered map.
strings.help_setting_5_location_discovery_experi: Experience for each newly discovered natural location.
strings.help_setting_5_new_biome_experience: Experience for entering a new biome.
strings.help_setting_5_land_radius_at_100: Percent larger land radius at level 100, scaling from level 0.
strings.help_setting_5_weather_penalty_reduction: Percent reduction of fog, mist and snow penalties at level 100.
strings.help_setting_5_night_penalty_reduction_a: Percent reduction of darkness penalties at level 100.
strings.help_setting_5_vantage_level: Unlock Vantage at this level; above 100 disables it.
strings.help_remove: Remove {0}. Off keeps the game effect.
strings.help_allow_removing: Allow players to remove {0}. Off keeps it on for everyone.
strings.help_setting_8_world_time_speed: Server-owned day/night cycle speed: 1 is normal (a full day and night takes 30 real minutes); 0.5 makes days and nights twice as long, 2 makes them half as long. Includes crops, events and world-time timers; multiplies Ember sleep acceleration. Applies live without moving the clock. Movement and real-time timers are unchanged; vanilla clients synchronize normally.
strings.help_setting_9_distance_fog_strength: Your distance fog density as a share of the game's: 1 keeps it, 0 clears it. Applies at once. Ignored while Remove Distance Fog is on or the server keeps distance fog.
strings.help_setting_9_mist_strength: Your mist and fog particle opacity (Mistlands mist, fog banks, weather fog) as a share of the game's: 1 keeps it, 0 hides it. Applies at once. Ignored while the server keeps Mistlands or particle mist; held at 1 on servers without Cairn.
strings.help_setting_9_smoke_strength: Your fire smoke opacity as a share of the game's: 1 keeps it, 0 hides it. Applies at once. Ignored while Remove Smoke is on or the server keeps smoke.
strings.help_setting_7_show_all_names_key: With Tidy Pins on, hold this key on the large map to show every pin name. None turns it off.
strings.help_setting_7_hovered_pin_scale: With Tidy Pins on, the pin under the cursor is drawn this many times larger. 1 turns it off.
